translations.web: It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.
translations.bsb: And this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves.
translations.kjv: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
translations.asv: And it will please Jehovah better than an ox, Or a bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
